1. Acceptance Of Terms

By accessing or using Sterrocloud services, infrastructure, websites, applications, and hosting products, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to comply with these Terms of Service. Continued usage of any service constitutes acceptance of all operational policies, billing conditions, and infrastructure guidelines maintained by Sterrocloud.

2. Services Provided

Sterrocloud provides infrastructure services including game server hosting, VPS hosting, web infrastructure, virtualization resources, storage systems, networking solutions, and related cloud-based services. Service specifications, limitations, and allocations may vary depending on purchased plans.

3. Billing & Payments

All services operate on prepaid billing cycles unless explicitly stated otherwise. Customers are responsible for maintaining valid payment methods and ensuring timely invoice settlements. Failure to complete payments before due dates may result in suspension, service interruption, or permanent termination of hosted services.

4. Refund Policy

Refund requests are reviewed individually depending on service type, provisioning status, and infrastructure usage. Services involving abuse, excessive resource consumption, policy violations, or completed deployments may become non-refundable. Chargeback abuse may result in immediate account suspension.

5. Prohibited Activities

Customers may not use Sterrocloud infrastructure for illegal activities, malicious software distribution, phishing, DDoS attacks, cryptocurrency mining, spam distribution, unauthorized access attempts, or any operation that threatens infrastructure stability, security, or network integrity.

6. Service Availability

While Sterrocloud aims to maintain stable and uninterrupted infrastructure, uptime is not guaranteed under all circumstances. Scheduled maintenance, emergency mitigation, hardware failures, upstream outages, and force majeure events may temporarily impact service availability.

7. Account Suspension & Termination

Sterrocloud reserves the right to suspend, restrict, or terminate services without prior notice in cases involving abuse, unpaid invoices, infrastructure misuse, policy violations, fraudulent transactions, or activities that may impact other customers or network stability.

8. Contact Information

For legal inquiries, billing concerns, abuse reports, or infrastructure support, customers may contact the Sterrocloud team directly through official communication channels provided on the Contact page.
